pages.description: At Plorix, we believe that online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
lines: At Plorix, we believe that online shopping should be accessible to people with different abilities and needs.
We aim to provide an inclusive website experience for customers who use assistive technologies, alternative navigation methods, or accessibility settings.
This Accessibility Statement describes our accessibility objectives, areas of focus, and how customers can request assistance.
Our website is operated by Plorix Electronics Inc. at https://plorix.us.
We aim to improve the accessibility and usability of our online electronics store.
Our objectives include making it easier for customers to:
Accessibility is an ongoing consideration in website design and maintenance.
We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a reference goal for accessibility improvements.
WCAG provides guidance for making web content more accessible to people with disabilities.
This statement does not represent a certification that every page or feature currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA.
Formal conformance claims should be supported by appropriate accessibility testing.
We aim to provide clear and understandable navigation throughout the website.
We aim to support keyboard navigation for essential website functions.
This includes the ability to access important controls without relying exclusively on a mouse.
Keyboard accessibility should be tested across menus, forms, shopping carts, and checkout functionality.
We aim to support compatibility with commonly used screen readers and assistive technologies.
This includes using meaningful headings, labels, and accessible names for interactive elements.
Actual compatibility may vary by device, browser, and assistive technology.
We aim to present website content in a readable format.
We aim to provide meaningful alternative text for informative images.
Decorative images may be marked appropriately so they do not create unnecessary interruptions for assistive technology users.
Product images should be described in a way that supports understanding of the product.
We aim to use appropriate contrast between text and backgrounds.
Important information should not depend exclusively on color.
Contrast should be tested across normal, hover, focus, disabled, and error states.
We recognize that checkout accessibility is especially important.
Third-party payment components should also be reviewed for accessibility.
We aim to support customers using mobile phones and tablets.
We aim to make product descriptions and specifications understandable and accessible.
This includes using structured content, readable tables, and clear terminology where practical.

We aim to review issues that affect essential customer functions and seek appropriate solutions.
Accessibility issues may occasionally arise because of technical changes, third-party components, or newly published content.
We welcome reports identifying specific barriers.
We do not claim that every potential accessibility issue has been identified or resolved.
Any claim of completed testing should be supported by actual assessment records.
If you experience difficulty accessing website content or completing a purchase, please contact us.

When reporting an accessibility barrier, please include:
* The device or browser used, if known
* Any assistive technology involved, if you wish to share
* The task you were trying to complete
Please do not provide sensitive medical information unless necessary and voluntarily chosen.
Where a website accessibility issue prevents a customer from accessing essential information or completing a task, our support team can review available alternative assistance.
Available options depend on the nature of the request and our operational capabilities.
We aim to improve accessibility through ongoing review of website functionality and customer feedback.
